In detail

This district covers Plateia Amerikis, the Attiki/Victoria Square area, Agios Panteleimonas and Kypseli, and has extensive, multi-year documentation of open drug dealing centred on Attiki and Victoria Squares and Agios Panteleimonas: a 2020 investigative report, a July 2024 crystal-meth arrest, and January 2025 trafficking arrests spanning Kypseli, Agios Panteleimonas and Plateia Amerikis. Agios Panteleimonas also has a documented history of anti-migrant vigilante violence between 2009 and 2012, recorded by Human Rights Watch in over two dozen separate attacks; EU- and municipally-funded redevelopment of the area has been underway since. Central Kypseli, particularly around Fokionos Negri, is explicitly described in the city's own tourism guide as a calm, gentrifying area distinct from the Attiki/Victoria Square pocket. Given the extensive, recurring documentation of drug dealing in specific parts of the district, day is rated yellow and night is rated red. Sources checked: iefimerida.gr; Hellenic Police astynomia.gr; ProtoThema English; Human Rights Watch "Hate on the Streets" (2012); Wikipedia "Viktoria Square"; This Is Athens.
